items.summary: Where do I begin, this is a great game first and foremost! The designs have captivating details and stand out for the portrayal of human bodies bleeding into the gory aspect, yet still keeping them elegant and balanced. It's so inspiring and freeing to look at as an artist myself. I love the game play, but I do have to note that it may be time consuming to go through some stages. I also wish there was more official merch to pick and choose my fav characters from. Overall- super recommended!! ^ω^

Unica raccomandazione: fate attenzione se siete anime sensibili, perché alcune scene sono da tortura psicologica, da perfetto horror 😂
